sources.observation: 3090 Ti dense BF16 GEMM with FP32 accumulation: 87.50 to 157.41 TFLOP/s; FP16 87.46 to 118.39. Linux Ampere issue-rate modification. Author/community measurements, not our workload or a vendor guarantee.
Initial report 18 October 2026; independent stock-driver confirmation and upstream-support closure follow. Board, power, driver and kernel details differ across reports.
TITAN RTX already lists 130.5 TFLOP/s FP16 with FP32 accumulation; BF16 is NA. No additional 2x TITAN unlock credit is justified.
Stock 3090 Ti dense BF16/FP16 with FP32 accumulation is 80 TFLOP/s per card; distinguish FP16 accumulation and structured sparsity columns.
Newton-Schulz explicitly casts its matrix to BF16; momentum follows parameter storage via zeros_like. BF16 GEMMs alone do not prove BF16 persistent optimizer state.
Hidden matrices use Muon; embeddings, output heads and gains/biases use auxiliary AdamW. The reference algorithm is not identical to the repository's no-Nesterov quantized-momentum variant.
Forward/backward, causal GQA, head sizes 64/96/128; no local mask. MiniCPM's 128-head geometry is potentially compatible; Spark's 256/local geometry requires another exact implementation.
CUDA low-precision attention support and architecture/head-dimension constraints must be checked before claiming a compatible backend.
FP16-only accumulation is a separate numerical setting; it is not equivalent to the reported unlock's FP32 accumulation.
On-demand H200 141 GB at $4.47/GPU-hour, H100 80 GB at $4.41, L40S 48 GB at $1.57. Rates do not establish account quota or inventory.
